title: My Neighborhood
text:
I live in a small neighborhood in the city. There is a park near my house. Many children play in the park after school. There is also a small bakery on my street.

The bakery sells fresh bread every morning. My mother buys bread there on Saturdays. My neighbors are very friendly. They always say hello to me.

questions.text: What is near the writer's house?
When does the bakery sell fresh bread?
How does the writer probably feel about the neighbors?
options: The writer does not know the neighbors
The writer is angry with the neighbors
The writer wants to move away from the neighbors

questions.text: What kind of place is the writer's neighborhood probably?
options: A place far from the city

vocabulary.definition: an area of a city where people live
a shop that sells bread and cakes
kind and pleasant to other people

paragraph_translations: Vivo en un barrio pequeño de la ciudad. Hay un parque cerca de mi casa. Muchos niños juegan en el parque después de la escuela. También hay una pequeña panadería en mi calle.
La panadería vende pan fresco cada mañana. Mi madre compra pan allí los sábados. Mis vecinos son muy amables. Siempre me saludan.
